inclusions: Complete civil demolition of identified partition wall with debris carting away to municipal yard.

1600x800mm High Gloss vitrified tile flooring in living area and AC4 German wooden flooring in master suite.

termsAndConditions: Quotation validity is strictly 30 calendar days from the date of issuance.

Any changes or additions to the agreed scope will be executed strictly via written and approved Variation Orders (VO).
All civil and structural waterproofing carries a 5-Year Build Storys Comprehensive Warranty against leakage.
Hardware and drawer systems carry manufacturer direct warranty (Hafele: 5-year mechanical warranty).

requirement.materialsBrandsPreferences: Kajaria Vitrified Tiles, Saint-Gobain Gyproc, Asian Paints Royale Luxury Emulsion, Hafele hardware, Century 710 Marine Plywood, KalingaStone Quartz
requirement.civilRequirements: Demolition of non-load bearing wall between dining and study room; make good edges with 12mm plaster and wire mesh.

requirement.siteAccessConstraints: Society working hours strictly 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM; no noisy work on Sundays; dedicated freight lift pass required.
requirement.surveyNotes: Ceiling height clear at 9.5 ft. Sub-slab in bathrooms clean. Balcony floor level has 50mm drop suitable for anti-skid tiles.
requirement.rawBriefHindiEnglish: Living room me Kajaria ki 1600x800 high gloss vitrified tiles chahiye Italian marble finish wali. Dining aur study ke beech ki partition wall demolish karni hai. Pure apartment me Saint Gobain gypsum ceiling with indirect LED cove lights. Kitchen me 100% waterproof BWP marine ply carcass with Senoplast acrylic shutters and white quartz countertop. Master bedroom me 10x8 sliding wardrobe with natural smoked walnut veneer and Italian PU polish. Master bathroom me 72 hours pond test ke sath Dr. Fixit waterproofing chahiye. Budget range 24-27 Lakhs.
